items.title: AdFection: Targeted ads turned into a pipeline for zero-click mercenary spyware
items.title_zh: AdFection：定向广告被武器化为零点击间谍软件投递通道
items.title_en: AdFection: Targeted Ads Weaponized as Zero-Click Spyware Delivery Channel
items.summary: Citizen Lab reports that targeted advertising infrastructure was abused as a pipeline to deliver zero-click mercenary spyware.

items.title: Muse Spark Open
items.title_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Spark Open：面向 Mac Studio 本地部署的 816B 开放权重模型
items.title_en: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open, 816B Open-Weight Model for Mac Studio
items.summary: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight AI model optimized for local deployment on Mac Studio, prompting debates about licensing and competitive performance.

items.title: I know why the mathematicians weep
items.title_zh: 随笔探讨AI冲击下数学家的存在主义焦虑
items.title_en: Essay probes mathematicians' existential dread as AI commodifies math
items.summary: An essay and community discussion examine why mathematicians feel existential dread as AI commodifies mathematical work and disrupts traditional validation of truth.

items.title: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO
items.title_zh: Anthropic 上市前披露季度营收近 168 亿美元，环比增长近 50%
items.title_en: Anthropic Reports Quarterly Revenue Up Nearly 50% to $16.8B Ahead of IPO
items.summary: Anthropic told investors its quarterly revenue rose nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of a potential IPO, revealing rapid growth, positive adjusted operating margins, and a $1.70 revenue-to-compute-spend ratio.

items.title: ASML Is Building a Hybrid Bonding Tool!
items.title_zh: ASML据传正在开发混合键合设备
items.title_en: ASML Reportedly Developing a Hybrid Bonding Tool
items.summary: ASML appears to be developing a hybrid bonding tool based on patent filings, a news report, and its own roadmap, though no official announcement has been made.

items.title: How artificial neural networks build their own learning machinery [R]
items.title_zh: 随机连接的神经网络可自组织出学习回路，性能媲美反向传播
items.title_en: Randomly Wired Networks Self-Assemble Learning Circuitry, Rivaling Backpropagation
items.summary: A PNAS paper covered by MIT shows that networks of randomly interconnected neuron-like units governed by shared local plasticity rules can self-assemble learning circuitry and match backpropagation performance on basic classification tasks.
